system.description: With the target in line of sight, spend a Willpower Trait and win a Static Mental Challenge (difficulty equal to the subject's Mental Traits) to learn her Nature, Demeanor, and whether she follows Humanity or a Path, plus any mental or spiritual influences such as Dominate, Presence, or infernal pacts. A second such challenge reveals Willpower and Humanity/Path scores, and a third reveals the state of the subject's karma (Storyteller adjudicated). Losing any challenge risks gaining one of the subject's derangements, Flaws, or negative Traits for the rest of the session, and forces you to restart the whole process from the beginning.
